column11: Relay-split forms (COORD 19:1x) tried. Every placement trades one hot spot for another. (a) The top band (259 um) holds only ~L8100 (2807 b): adding L1237 or L8101 legs there gives open_H 1.5. (b) Any vertical crossing of the top row needs a macro-free channel of about 230-280 um for L8101 + L1237 (4742 b). (c) L8101's E window (y 928-1158) sits beside the top row, so it also needs an E strip of 160 um or more. Free top-row width is 509 um, but the pretree blocks 207 of it; with the pretree moved, C3 still peaks at 1.24 in the middle band near the turn. The +1 station does not add capacity. Die-level asks, any one of: (1) move L8101's E window into the middle band (y <= 985) with the E-neighbour re-pin; (2) carry L8101 or L1237 around su30 in a die ft band; (3) spread the 7549-b N windows (x 440-1156) wider, with the hub S mirror. column11: DIE-LAYOUT-HBM asked (W' not composable) for a continuous V street >= 150 um inside the fixed outlines. Arithmetic: the macros need >= 528 um of column width over 1555 um. 528 + 150 = 678 against 708, so the rest would have to pack at about 95%, and the unit heights (187.5 / 290.3) bin-pack to >= 644 + 150 = 794 > 708. Infeasible without squeezing. Options under study: unit-local stacking (each h1 abutted on its own ra|rb pair, 3 unit columns 3/3/2) with the broadcast spine in a street; or move 1-2 units per type (outline/arch).
